name: ply
description: Zero-dependency git smart-HTTP client: blobless partial fetch, streamed single-file edit, thin delta push. OTLP spans built in.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.check.json && tsc -p tsconfig.isolated.json && node scripts/ts-ratchet.mjs
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings src && oxlint -c oxlint.loose.json src test scripts examples
scripts.test: vitest run && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/run.mjs --n 60 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/hostile.mjs --n 60 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/hostile.mjs --case 2366521731 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/below-hash.mjs --n 20 --seed 1 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/below-hash.mjs --seed 20261030 --n 100 --case 1730047880 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/git-semantic.mjs --n 20 --seed 1 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/liar.mjs --n 60 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/liar.mjs --op mergebase --n 40 --seed 1 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/protocol.mjs --n 100 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/packs.mjs --n 40 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/packgen.mjs --n 60 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/codec.mjs --n 20000 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/usergiven.mjs && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/attributes.mjs --n 40 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 300 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 200 --runs && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 150 --driver union && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 60 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 4 --huge
scripts.fuzz:long: node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/run.mjs --n 1000 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/hostile.mjs --n 1000 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/below-hash.mjs --n 400 --seed 1 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/git-semantic.mjs --n 200 --seed 1 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/liar.mjs --n 1000 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/protocol.mjs --n 1000 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/packgen.mjs --n 500 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/codec.mjs --n 300000 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 20000 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 5000 --runs && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 1000 && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 200 --snake && node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 50 --huge
scripts.test:git: vitest run test/compliance.test.js test/parity.test.js test/push.test.js test/push-tree.test.js test/checkout-tree.test.js test/packcache.test.js
scripts.test:space: vitest run test/space/push-outcome.test.js test/space/push-outcome-boundary.test.js test/space/fsck-tree.test.js test/space/advertisement.test.js test/space/pack-cut.test.js test/space/pkt-frame.test.js test/space/push-ng.test.js test/space/refname.test.js test/space/ssh-faults.test.js test/space/ssh-service.test.js
scripts.coverage: rm -rf /tmp/ply-cov && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --test test/props.test.js test/oracle.test.js test/concurrency.test.js test/edges.test.js test/adversarial.test.js test/compliance.test.js test/packcache.test.js test/pure.test.js test/sign.test.js test/merge.test.js test/linemerge.test.js test/rebase.test.js test/sshgit.test.js && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/run.mjs --n 60 --seed 11 && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/hostile.mjs --n 60 --seed 12 && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/protocol.mjs --n 80 --seed 32 && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/packs.mjs --n 30 --seed 5; NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 200 --runs && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 200 --rediff undecided && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 40 --snake && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 3 --huge && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/attributes.mjs --n 40 && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 200 --driver union && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 50 --driver binary; node --import ./test/ts-resolve.mjs test/coverage.mjs /tmp/ply-cov --lines
